description: The device-wide Location Services switch is off while this app's own authorization still reads granted. A Settings-level fix, so it is NOT ready: capture would never start, and the engine must show the takeover instead of polling a watch that cannot begin. Reported as a permission denial because the remedy is the same shape (a trip to Settings, not an in-app ask). Today's iOS folds this into an app-level denial by itself (device-tested); the key exists so the refusal rule does not depend on that folding, and so readiness and the watch's pre-capture gate read the same inputs.
